judged_text: The new controller spec asserts only that the class inherits from AdminController and never exercises create/update/destroy or save_host at all. Real controller behavior — params[:embeddable_host][:host] extraction, the blank category_id fallback to SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id, validation-failure render_json_error, and destroy of a nonexistent id (host.destroy on nil raises NoMethodError) — ships with zero verification; a regression in save_host passes CI. Same pattern in spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb:4-8.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new controllers with unhandled nil records: in Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update and #destroy, `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` can return nil, but the code then calls `save_host(host)` (which immediately does `host.host = ...`) or `host.destroy`, both of which would raise NoMethodError for a nonexistent id. The new controller specs indeed only assert inheritance and do not exercise these paths, so CI would not catch this behavior.
